owning_after.scope_note: Outside fixed historical selection; no newer owning-after run included or assessed.

checks_and_resource_crossings.default_check: PASS bounded; six manifest deprecations retained
checks_and_resource_crossings.interpretation: Reported resource crossings preserved; no terminal memory events, OOM/enforcement/causality inference. CPU quota is not consumption.

limitations: Independent gate covers the inspected39-pair/41-file candidate. Six account occurrences and linked identities found in the initial privacy FAIL were corrected with exact literals; no universal privacy guarantee.

Whole UTF-8 originals transformed only by ordered exact str.replace; LF appended only when absent. No clipping, JSON payload reserialization or newline normalization. Redacted JSON-like evidence is retained text, not promised parseable JSON.

Historical results are separate and nonadditive. Nested one-case summaries do not double the eleven-case Retail/PTR totals. Receipt-schema and executable-path/mode corrections retain prelaunch/setup history.

Existing executable digests are recorded TEXT only; no executable/archive/closed-packet reads, hashing, copies or workload launches. Source association and preserved digests do not freshly authenticate source, dependencies, caches or libraries.

Normal observations disable CASC/sound/third-party addons/ordinary SavedVariables; font fallback, warm bytecode cache and read-only WTF EditMode cache still used. Not all-addon/rendering/native/current-HEAD/full-suite/parent completion proof. No owning-after run.
